mastery_task.scenario_en: You meet a fictional class partner and need four details for a pair task.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: تقابل زميل خيالي وتحتاج أربع معلومات لمهمة ثنائية.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Ask for name, origin, residence, and job; answer the partner's changed questions.
mastery_task.support: Detail icons only; no full question or answer frames.
mastery_task.freshness: The partner, missing details, order, and repair need differ from practice.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: You welcome a fictional volunteer and complete a verbal contact check.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: ترحب بمتطوع خيالي وتراجع بياناته شفهيًا.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Exchange four changed personal details and repair one unclear name or job.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Detail icons only; no full question or answer frames.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: The role, information gap, and repair target are new.

rubric.level_2: Questions and answers address the intended missing details.
Four details are exchanged successfully in both directions.
The learner adapts to changed question order and partner details.
One unclear key detail is checked, repeated, or spelled successfully.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح الفرق بين Where are you from? وWhere do you live? واذكر طريقة إصلاح واحدة.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Ask for two changed details and confirm one.
Repair a new unclear fictional name.
Complete a new four-detail two-way exchange.
